license_status: No LICENSE or COPYING file was present in the audited recursive repository tree. This implementation was independently written from the architecture/operator specification; no author source files are redistributed.
paper: Chen et al., Graph-Based 3D Human Pose Estimation Using WiFi Signals, ICASSP 2026

architecture.encoder: Shared ResNet34 layer1/layer2/layer3/layer4; 1-channel 3x3 stride-1 stem; no maxpool; each antenna processed sequentially
architecture.resize_operator: bilinear, align_corners=false, antialias=true (torchvision Resize default in source torch2.7 environment)
architecture.aggregation: attn2: 512-to-256 Conv2d projection, time softmax then antenna softmax, LayerNorm(256)
architecture.graph: MM-Fi 17-joint undirected bones plus self loops, row normalized; exactly matches attack/payload.py MMFI_EDGES
architecture.graformer: 256-to-128 order-2 ChebConv, four attention/learned-graph plus residual-Cheb blocks, 128-to-3 order-2 ChebConv; four attention heads, dropout .1
architecture.graph_attention_norm: sample standard deviation (unbiased=true), epsilon=1e-6; not nn.LayerNorm

interface_and_safety_differences: Accepts repository CSI [B,3,114,10], retaining optional source singleton [B,3,114,10,1]
Pose gains singleton person axis: [B,1,17,3]; source joint features remain [B,17,256]
Fixed adjacency and all-true masks are registered buffers instead of construction-time global CUDA tensors
Strict MM-Fi 17-joint single-person default architecture only; non-default mean/mhsa ablations are not exposed
No ImageNet download or pretraining: pretrained=false, matching source train.py default flag state
Unused source imports, unused JointMLPHead and non-default aggregator implementations are not included

native_training_specification_not_an_exe.weight_decay_exclusions: BatchNorm1d/2d, LayerNorm, GroupNorm direct parameters; names ending .bias; all one-dimensional parameters
native_training_specification_not_an_exe.source_checkpoint_selection: Author saves best official validation/test metrics; new attack study must state its fixed final-epoch selection instead of silently using attack/test selection
native_training_specification_not_an_exe.source_parameter_order_issue: Source param_groups_simple uses sets; deterministic named-parameter order with identical decay membership is required in the new runner for portable optimizer resume

validation_status: Local synthetic shape/operator/source-parity tests are not full MM-Fi clean reproduction or full attack experiments.
